The data change is column-additive and the rows are a regenerable LLM cache; the repo has three tested precedents and rollback-drill.test.ts pins downgrade shape+writability. verdicts.floor_notes: M 6/8/6, 9 files + 3 new, est. ~450 lines. Tenancy: EXEMPT needs only a manifest entry with reasoning (billing_events at tenancy.ts:346-360 is the model; orgExportClass maps exempt to 'exclude'); tenancy-coverage.test.ts greps every CREATE TABLE under app/_lib, so if the table is created via openStore in webhook-claims.ts it must also join TENANCY_LAZY_TABLES - creating it in core.ts (card's step 5) avoids that.
